turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Thanks for seeing me, Hale. Owen found out about this on his phone, in the middle of your class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so tell me why my son has a zero.
Sit down, Hale. Tell me what you're going to do about the zero.
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.
You're offering me a mark to make a complaint go away. I'm writing that down. I'll be in the principal's office before my call at 4:40, and this is not something Owen gets bought out of.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No deal. Nothing gets settled in a hallway deal, and I'm not keeping quiet about my son's record. Put the zero withdrawn in writing, or I'm going upstairs.
